company.name: The List
company.shortDescription: The List is a retail marketplace connecting the world of fashion through intelligent software.
company.description: The List is a retail marketplace connecting the world of fashion through intelligent software. It is a global mobile platform providing anyone with immediate and seamless access to the world of fashion anytime, anywhere. The List enables consumers to shop incredible products from the world’s best boutiques and brands and have them delivered directly to their doorstep in over 190 countries. The platform provides its partners with a Machine Learning-based supply chain integration to ensure easy and automated inventory management in real-time. With its iOS mobile application, THE LIST has launched a drop model to the regular marketplace, providing consumers the opportunity to purchase highly demanded, limited, and hard-to-get globally sourced products without VIP status, waitlist, or queue at dynamic market prices driven by Artificial Intelligence.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,500,000, or 58.82% of reported total funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,110,391 to $22,101,802, a 19.9x increase.
